question: M starts cycling 64 meters straight from her office. During her journey she took 16 right turns. Finally she is facing towards west direction. In which direction she started cycling? (she took no left turn)
solution:
Given: 

M starts cycling 64 meters straight from her office.

During her journey she took 16 right turns. 

Finally she is facing towards west direction. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58def8195c14d6f2c0b254688a25b38850a0fbda2d7f8d2a9051998047b5325d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89b40dab12fcbc951f85a8e88630f0e956e52fb938167d954b8c39979b222e4f.png] &l
t;/p>

So, She started cycling **West.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
